findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_email" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "founder?ppr=ppc_mcpregistry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resend_verification, create_application, verify_email, update_application, get_status · Private data: create_application, update_application · Public sink: create_application, verify_email, submit_answers, update_application, get_status · Destructive: submit_answers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resend_verification, create_application, verify_email, update_application, get_status · Private data: create_application, update_application · Public sink: create_application, verify_email, submit_answers, update_application, get_status · Destructive: submit_answers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
